raw_segments.text: The rain began to fall again, and for a while it was too misty to see what the troops were
They had made a big half-circle across the plain, and were spreading out into a line.
That line grew and grew and grew till it was three-quarters of a mile long from wing to
wing one solid wall of men, horses, and guns.
Then it came on straight toward the Viceroy and the Amir, and as it got nearer the ground
began to shake, like the deck of a steamer when the engines are going fast.
The rain began to shake and grew till it was three-quarters of a mile from wing to wing
